- **Source:** `Codex`

Claude's concern was confirmed enough to act: broad exposure tier raises were reverted, and the lane tape adapter was moved to observation-only (`mode: shadow`, `admission_mode: off`). Resolution-only replay tightened 7 lanes, while full-journal replay tightened 22, so live de-sizing/min-edge deltas are paused until the rule is re-derived without stop-layer confounding.
